source.verbatim_statement: In this paper, a new algorithm for performing quantifier elimination from first order formulas over real closed fields is given.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the abstract and matched to Theorem 1.3.1 of the published Journal of the ACM article.

proposed_statement_changes.reason: The cited source attests existence of an algorithm for quantifier elimination over real closed fields, but the supplied quotation does not attest the stronger ordered coefficient-domain, sign-determination, or polynomial-sign output-normal-form guarantees.
